compatibility: the five legacy tool names already aliased by the session tools keep their alias, read from hooks.memory.api.records.ALIASES, still gated by AGENTIHOOKS_SESSION_ALIASES and expiring on 2027-01-31; every other legacy capability is replaced by a named agentihooks interface or removed with its retired feature
evidence_class: mocked: the consumer inventory is a fixture and a JSON file stands in for the authoritative migration record; the known consumer list was read from antoncore and agentibrain-kernel source, and no legacy service, gateway or dashboard was called

fixture_inputs.dashboard_metric_reader: the landing sessions indexed figure read from the legacy sessions endpoint
fixture_inputs.obsolete_dispatcher: a workforce caller of the legacy task dispatch tool
fixture_inputs.search_caller: an agent memory call to the legacy semantic search tool

interfaces: hooks.memory.compatibility.classify gives a consumer entry alias with its session tool, replace with its agentihooks target or remove with its retired feature; an unknown capability stays unmapped and a malformed entry is refused without echoing it

hooks.memory.compatibility.extract names the agentihooks module for turn chunking, vector storage and semantic search with the MIT source license and copied false; it refuses dispatcher, registry, daemon and every other retired feature even when they share a source module

hooks.memory.compatibility.Inventory.add records a consumer at a newer revision, replays an identical entry without change and refuses a different entry at a stale revision; report counts migration_unmapped_consumers
hooks.memory.compatibility.CONSUMERS holds the known consumers across tools, dashboards, deployment, ingestion and brain extraction, with zero unmapped
metrics: migration_unmapped_consumers counts inventory items whose capability has neither a target nor a removal decision

outcomes.accepted: items held in the inventory record at its revision
outcomes.committed: the inventory record written to the fixture JSON file and read back
outcomes.externally_verified: none; no consumer was migrated or removed in antoncore or agentibrain-kernel
outcomes.observed: case outputs in the a, b and c result files from the focused fixture run

remaining_limitations: The inventory is a static list read from source on 2026-10-27; a consumer outside antoncore, agentibrain-kernel and this repository was not searched for.
The antoncore and agentibrain-kernel changes the inventory calls for are not made here; each is its own pull request in that repository, antoncore through GitOps.
The landing sessions indexed figure has no HTTP replacement endpoint yet; session_list over the catalog is its target.
Inventory has no lock; one writer updates the record at a time.
rollback_rehearsal: B refused retired extractions, malformed entries and a stale reclassification and the inventory record was byte identical afterwards; the alias gate stays off by default, so no replacement alias answers until AGENTIHOOKS_SESSION_ALIASES is set

spec_mapping.attribution: no legacy source was copied; the extractable components already exist in hooks.memory, so extract records the source license and copied false instead of a copied notice
spec_mapping.historical_data: the backup of the legacy session databases is replaced by hooks.memory.importer; the databases stay read only until imported

supported_versions: session tools and alias table of SV2-IDX-05
